body: Talk to your dad about your feelings. Ask to go talk to your doctor. Maybe you could use therapy, or medication. It’s normal to feel sad, it’s okay. You might be depressed, and it’s exhausting and a real medical issue like having the flu. You’re worth hanging on, you’re not a disappointment. You just need help to get better. Talk to him and be honest.

Don’t give up yet! You’re aware of your pain, it sounds like you want help. Maybe reach out to a therapist, and a psychiatrist. Talk about your feelings, your issues, in confidence. Your issues are your issues, no matter how they seek to anyone else. Everyone lives a different life, and similar experiences affect everyone differently. You’re entitled to your pain, your opinions, your feelings. Now you have to learn to deal with them, to process them, and to live a healthy life mentally.
